goal: Validate the frozen minimal-blueprint MVP, quantify structural efficiency, exercise the formal server, and compare raw, flat-complete, and CGKN-structured evidence on two qualified models.
acceptance_criteria: fresh CSV generation and a non-blank-row seeded repair pass without manual edits
three independent CSV runs pass within the unchanged eight-call budget
M0/M1 and V0/V0B/V1/V2 results use frozen semantics and official pricing
formal server supported capabilities are exercised through a live protocol process
Qwen and DeepSeek each run the frozen 28-case R0/R1/R2 taskset
full canonical-Python regression has zero failures and zero errors

improvement: separated task-stated constraints from external evidence in the model benchmark

feedback: Frozen MVP reliability closed at CSV 3/3 plus a distinct seeded repair.
Cheap execution qualified economically; Blueprint and role separation did not show benefit in this sample.
CGKN structured evidence reduced irrelevant context and tokens per successful evidence case directionally.
The Multi-Agent gate remains closed because the installed formal server does not expose Conversation.
